failures.desc: Search suggest dropdown empty despite HTTP 200 API response
failures.detail: Typing 'gre' in #listora-keyword fires GET /wp-json/listora/v1/search/suggest?q=gre (HTTP 200, ~1074ms). aria-expanded flips to true and #listora-suggestions listbox becomes visible (data-wp-bind--hidden removes hidden). Zero items are rendered. The IAPI store (listora/directory) is not writing the suggest API response into state.suggestions. The fetch is firing correctly; the IAPI action handler is not populating the DOM.
failures.reproduce: Navigate to /listings/. Type 3+ chars in keyword search input. Wait 2s. Listbox is visible but empty.

failures.desc: Anon login modal missing Create Account CTA
failures.detail: Clicking Save to favorites as anonymous user triggers auth modal with heading 'Log in to save listings'. Modal contains only a 'Log in' link (href: /wp-login.php?redirect_to=...). No 'Create account', 'Register', or 'Sign up' link/button present. Runbook contract requires both Login and Register options in the modal.
failures.reproduce: Open /listing/union-square-greenmarket/ without login. Click Save to favorites. Inspect modal — only Log In present.
failures.component: Free / auth modal template or class-auth-modal.php

failures.desc: Single listing REST response missing created_at and updated_at fields
failures.detail: GET /wp-json/listora/v1/listings/725?_fields=id,title,created_at,updated_at returns only {id, status, title, listing_type}. The timestamp fields are not registered in the REST schema for single listing resources.

failures.desc: S8 runbook claims 7 Pro AS jobs always scheduled — actual scheduling is toggle-gated
failures.detail: expire_needs only schedules when reverse_listings toggle ON. deliver_webhook and webhook_log_cleanup only schedule when outgoing_webhooks ON. When toggles are OFF, jobs correctly do not exist. The S8 runbook text 'all 7 jobs scheduled' is misleading. Classification: documentation bug.

failures.desc: S6 runbook references 'EDD SL endpoint' but implementation uses LMFWC
failures.detail: Pro's class-updater.php uses LMFWC at wblistora.com/wp-json/lmfwc/v2/updates/, not EDD Software Licensing. The updater is functionally correct. Documentation terminology mismatch only.

failures.desc: Cron hook names in runbook do not match source code constants
failures.detail: Actual Free cron hooks: wb_listora_check_expirations, wb_listora_draft_reminder_cron, wb_listora_daily_cleanup. Runbook section C/G may reference different names. Documentation debt.
